hero.eyebrow: The baby journal, shared with family
hero.title: Every little day deserves its own page.
hero.intro: Le petit monde is the private journal where you note baby's progress, photos, and videos — and where the whole family can come turn the pages, gently, without ever leaving home.
hero.mockCaption: All the way to the couch, without falling even once. Grandma is going to be so proud. 🎉

pages.title: One journal, three pages
pages.subtitle: No features to learn — just the moments a family wants to keep.

daily.title: A page a day
daily.text: A nap, a smile, a first word: note them down with photos and videos, sorted automatically by date.

calendar.title: A calendar that grows
calendar.text: Appointments, growth spurts, firsts: everything that matters, right where you think to look for it.

guessing.title: The guessing game
guessing.text: First name, weight, birth date: grandparents and godparents try their luck, sometimes before day one.

steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: Four steps, and the journal runs itself.

create.title: Create baby's journal
create.text: A private space all their own, ready in seconds — one journal per child.

circles.title: Form circles
circles.text: Grandparents, godparents, cousins: everyone joins one or more circles, and only sees what's meant for them.

publish.title: Publish day by day
publish.text: Photos, videos, little notes: every post lands in the journal, sorted by date, with reactions and comments.

calendar.title: Keep the calendar current
calendar.text: Appointments, growth spurts, firsts: everything in one place, visible to the right circle.

night.title: A journal you close, at night.
night.text: No news feed, no strangers, no likes to collect. {appName} runs on your own server, built for one family at a time — yours.
night.hosted: Hosted by you, for your peace of mind

finalCta.title: The first page is waiting.
finalCta.text: Add your baby, invite the family, and let the journal write itself, day by day.
